richiami.difetto: The wheel chair lift may collapse due to weld failure. Whilst this is likely to be restricted to a particular batch of units the manufacturer will rework all the subject lifts as a precautionary measure.
richiami.rimedio: The end user will be advised by the manufacturer to take affected vehicles to Ratcliff agents for inspection and if required modification.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF WHEEL CHAIR LIFT PLATFORM
